items.hint: Did the short hand move on, or did only the long hand move?
steps: It ends at 4:30. The long hand went half way round.
The class lasts half an hour.

slips.say: The long hand went half way round, not all the way round. That is half an hour.

tpl.q: The class starts at {h}:00 and ends at {e}:{m|mm}. How long is the class?
tpl.hint: Did the short hand move on, or did only the long hand move?

items.q: A film lasts half an hour. How many minutes is that?
items.hint: An hour is 60 minutes. Half of 60 is?

slips.say: 60 minutes is a whole hour. Half an hour is half of that.
15 minutes is a quarter of an hour. Half an hour is 30 minutes.

items.q: Ravi starts to read at half past 4. He reads for half an hour. What time does he stop?
items.hint: The long hand goes from the 6 round to the 12. The hour changes.
steps: The long hand goes from the 6 to the 12, so the short hand moves on.

items.q: Ravi rides a bus for 1 hour. Then he walks for half an hour. He gets home at 5:00 pm. What time did the bus ride start?
items.hint: Go back half an hour, then go back 1 hour.
steps: Half an hour back from 5:00 is 4:30. He started to walk at 4:30.

tpl.q: Ravi rides a bus for 1 hour. Then he walks for half an hour. He gets home at {h}:00 pm. What time did the bus ride start?
tpl.hint: Go back half an hour, then go back 1 hour.
steps: Half an hour back from {h}:00 is {p}:30. He started to walk then.

items.q: A film lasts 1 hour and half an hour. How many minutes is that?
items.hint: 1 hour is 60 minutes. Add half an hour.

slips.say: 60 minutes is only the 1 hour. Add the half an hour too.
1 hour and half an hour is not 130. 1 hour is 60 minutes and half an hour is 30 minutes.

items.q: Make a time puzzle for a grown-up. Pick a start time, say how long it lasts, and ask when it ends. Check the answer on your clock.
items.hint: Pick the start first, then move the hands.
steps: Write the start time and how long it lasts.
Move the hands on your clock to find the end.
Ask a grown-up, then check together.
